generators.version: bpy 5.2.2 LTS (PyPI wheel), Cycles CPU + OpenImageDenoise

generators.notes: Room, eight Workspace Upgrade props, lighting, toon materials, Freestyle outlines, and the canonical camera all come from scene.py. render_pack.py renders the empty room and each prop from the same camera (occluding props as holdouts, PS-247); process_pack.py trims and places them. PS-250E1 adds a night lighting of the same scene (no sun, glowing sconces, a night sky and lit skyline; --lighting night), rendered to -night files with their own trim boxes.

processors.purpose: Full-frame renders: empty room with transparent film, then each prop with room surfaces and its support as shadow catchers so contact shadows stay in the prop, and any PROP_OCCLUDERS as holdout-material occluders so hidden parts are cut out
Backdrop composite and WebP encode for the room; alpha trim with a noise floor and speck filter for props; placement derived from the trimmed box; per-phase QA previews

camera.notes: Fixed three-quarter overhead view (scene.CAMERA). Calibrated so a 1.7 m figure at the protagonist's floor position projects at the same height as the chibi protagonist sprite drawn at 24% width.
